result.title: VCoT-SQL: Enhancing Text-to-SQL Generation through Dual Chain-of-Thought Validation Training
result.summary: Open-source LLMs provide a flexible alternative to closed-source models for Text-to-SQL but still struggle with complex queries. Finetuning with chain-of-thought (CoT) data improves reasoning, yet standard datasets lack CoT annotations, requiring synthetic generation. Existing synthesis methods only verify the final answer, allowing flawed reasoning steps to corrupt the training data. We propose VCoT-SQL, a framework that improves Text-to-SQL generation through intermediate-step validated CoT supervision and a dedicated SQL validator, which enables small open-source models to outperform frontier closed-source models. VCoT-SQL trains two complementary models on curated reasoning traces: an SQL generator using clause-level CoT templates where reasoning steps are verified via execution and schema alignment checks, and an SQL validator using diagnostic CoT templates to detect syntactic, semantic, and type level errors. We further design a hierarchical schema filtering pipeline that integrates and refines complementary retrieval strategies to distill relevant database elements. VCoT-SQL achieves 66.82% execution accuracy on challenging dataset BIRD dev and 86.8% on Spider test, improving the base 7B model by 7% on BIRD. Notably, our CoT synthesis relies on 7B models yet outperforms methods that use 72B-scale or even proprietary closed source teachers for data generation, demonstrating that rigorous step-level validation can be more effective than scaling up teacher model size. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/INTREBID/VCoT-SQL.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VCoT-SQL，用 clause 级 CoT 模板与执行、schema 对齐检查核验中间推理步，再训练独立的 SQL validator 诊断语法、语义与类型错误，并配合分层 schema 过滤，以 7B 开源模型在 BIRD、Spider 上取得较强执行准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: “逐步验证而非仅验证终答案”的合成监督与专用 validator，可能为 LVR 推理轨迹训练中的数据筛选、贡献分配与错误诊断提供可核查线索；但任务为纯文本 SQL，无视觉状态或 latent 表示相关证据。
